units.title: Understanding Academic Lectures

source_refs.file: B1专八历年真题+听力+解析/01.历年真题+解析/2015年专八真题+音频+解析/2015年英语专八真题解析.pdf

sentences.en: Good morning, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now, at the university, you, as students, are often called on to perform many types of listening tasks: listening in a group discussion, listening to a teacher on a one-to-one basis, and listening to academic lectures.
sentences.zh: 在大学里，作为学生，你们经常需要完成各种听力任务：听小组讨论、与老师一对一交谈，以及听学术讲座。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So what I’m going to talk about today is what a listener needs to be able to do in order to comprehend an academic lecture efficiently.
sentences.zh: 因此，今天我要讲的是，听众要具备哪些能力，才能高效地理解一场学术讲座。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: What do you need to do in order to understand the lecture?
sentences.zh: 要听懂讲座，你需要做些什么呢？
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now there are four things that I’m going to talk about.
sentences.zh: 接下来，我要谈四个方面。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: The first thing is that you need to be aware of all of the parts of the language that carry meaning.
sentences.zh: 首先，你需要意识到，语言中所有能够传达意义的组成部分都值得注意。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: You all know that words carry meaning.
sentences.zh: 你们都知道，词语能够传达意义。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So you've got to be aware of the vocabulary of the language, but there are some other features.
sentences.zh: 所以，你必须了解这门语言的词汇，但除此之外，还有其他特征。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: For one thing, you need to be aware of stress.
sentences.zh: 例如，你需要注意重音。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Let me give you an example.
sentences.zh: 我来举个例子。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: “I went to the bar.” “I went to the bar.” It makes a difference.
sentences.zh: “我去了酒吧。”“是我去了酒吧。”这样读，意思就有所不同。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: In the second example, I’m stressing the fact that it was me and not someone else so that this means stress has some meaning.
sentences.zh: 在第二个例子里，我强调的是去酒吧的人是我，而不是别人；这就说明，重音本身也传递意义。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now the next thing you might want to listen for is intonation.
sentences.zh: 接下来，你可能需要留意的是语调。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: For example, if I say “He came.” “He came?” There are two different meanings.
sentences.zh: 比如，我说“他来了。”“他来了？”这两句话表达的是不同的意思。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: One is a statement, the other one is a question.
sentences.zh: 一个是陈述，另一个是提问。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And another thing you need to listen for is rhythm.
sentences.zh: 你还需要留意节奏。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: For instance, “Can you see, Mary?” versus “Can you see Mary?” da da DA da... da da da DA da.
sentences.zh: 比如，“玛丽，你看得见吗？”与“你看得见玛丽吗？”——哒哒哒哒……哒哒哒哒。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Those two mean something different.
sentences.zh: 这两种说法表达的意思不同。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: In the first one, they are talking directly to Mary, while the second one means “Can you see Mary... over there?”
sentences.zh: 第一种说法是直接对玛丽说话，而第二种则是问：“你看得见那边的玛丽吗？”
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now the next thing you must do when you listen is that you need to add information that the lecturer expects you to add.
sentences.zh: 接下来，听的时候你还必须补充一些信息，而讲课人会预期你能够自行补上这些信息。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: All lecturers assume that they share some information with their audience and that their audience does not need them to explain every word.
sentences.zh: 所有讲课人都会假定，自己与听众掌握着某些共同信息，因此不必逐字解释每个词。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And listeners have an ability to add this information due to two sources of information.
sentences.zh: 听众能够补充这些信息，是因为他们有两种信息来源。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: That is, one, their knowledge of a particular subject; and, two, their knowledge or experience of the world.
sentences.zh: 第一，是对某个特定学科的了解；第二，是对世界的知识或生活经验。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So remember: listening is not a matter of just absorbing the speaker’s words; the listener has to do more than that.
sentences.zh: 所以，请记住：听讲并不是仅仅接收说话人的话语，听众还需要做得更多。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: The listener is not a tape recorder, absorbing the speaker’s words and putting them into his or her brain.
sentences.zh: 听众不是录音机，不会只是接收说话人的话，再把这些话存进脑海。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Rather, listening involves hearing the speaker's words and reinterpreting them, adding information if necessary.
sentences.zh: 相反，听的过程包括听见说话人的话、重新理解这些话，并在必要时补充信息。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So the meaning is not in the word alone, rather it is in the person who uses it or responds to it so that the second thing that a listener must do— add information that the lecturer assumes that they share.
sentences.zh: 因此，意义并不只存在于词语本身，也存在于使用这些词语、或对其作出回应的人身上。所以，听众要做的第二件事，就是补充讲课人假定双方都知道的信息。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: The third thing that a listener needs to do, and this is to me the most important thing of all, and that’s to predict as you listen.
sentences.zh: 听众需要做的第三件事——在我看来也是最重要的一件事——就是边听边预测。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now let me give you two reasons why you have to predict.
sentences.zh: 现在，我来解释为什么要预测，原因有两个。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: For one thing, if you predict it helps you overcome noise.
sentences.zh: 首先，预测有助于你克服噪声的干扰。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: What do I mean by noise?
sentences.zh: 这里所说的“噪声”是什么意思呢？
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Maybe there’s noise outside and you can’t hear me.
sentences.zh: 也许外面很吵，以至于你听不见我说话。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Maybe you're in the back of the room and you can’t hear all that well.
sentences.zh: 也许你坐在教室后面，听得不太清楚。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Maybe the microphone doesn’t work.
sentences.zh: 也许麦克风出了故障。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Maybe there’s noise inside your head.
sentences.zh: 也许噪声来自你的脑海。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: By that I mean maybe you're thinking of something else.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可能正在想着其他事情。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden, you'll remember “Oh, I’ve got to listen.” By being able to predict during the lecture, you can just keep listening to the lecture and not lose the idea of what’s going on.
sentences.zh: 随后，你会突然想起来：“哦，我得认真听。”如果你能在听讲时进行预测，就能继续跟上讲座，而不会失去对当前内容的理解。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So predicting is important to help you overcome outside noise and inside noise.
sentences.zh: 所以，预测对于克服外部噪声和内心干扰都很重要。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And another reason that predicting is important is because it saves you time.
sentences.zh: 预测之所以重要，还有一个原因，那就是它能节省时间。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now when you listen you need time to think about the information, relate it to old ideas, take notes, and if you’re only keeping up with what I’m saying or what the lecturer’s saying, you have no time to do that.
sentences.zh: 听讲时，你需要时间来思考信息、把它与已有的想法联系起来，以及记笔记；如果你只是勉强跟上我或讲课人的讲话，就没有时间做这些事了。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And I’ll bet a lot of you are having that problem right now because it’s so hard just to follow everything I’m saying, that you don’t have time to note down ideas.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，你们中很多人现在就有这个问题：光是跟上我说的全部内容，就已经很费力了，因而没有时间记下要点。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So predicting saves you time.
sentences.zh: 因此，预测可以节省时间。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: If you can guess what I’m going to say, you're able to take notes, you’re able to think, you have more time.
sentences.zh: 如果你能猜到我接下来会说什么，就能记笔记，也能进行思考，你就拥有更多时间。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: OK?
sentences.zh: 明白吗？
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And there are two types of predictions that you can make: predictions of content and predictions of organization.
sentences.zh: 你可以作出两类预测：对内容的预测，以及对组织结构的预测。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Let me give you an example in terms of content.
sentences.zh: 我先举一个预测内容的例子。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: If you hear the words “Because he loved to cook, his favorite room was...” what would you expect?
sentences.zh: 如果你听到“因为他喜欢做饭，他最喜欢的房间是……”这些话，你会预期接下来出现什么词？
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Kitchen.
sentences.zh: 厨房。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: You can guess this because you know people cook in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 你能猜到这一点，是因为你知道人们通常在厨房里做饭。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: OK?
sentences.zh: 明白吗？
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And you can also predict organization.
sentences.zh: 你也可以预测讲话的组织结构。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So if I was going to tell you a story, you'd expect me to tell you why the story is important, give you a setting for the story.
sentences.zh: 比如，如果我要给你讲一个故事，你就会期待我先说明这个故事为什么重要，并交代故事发生的背景。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So you have expectations of what the speaker is going to talk about and how the speaker will organize his or her words.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于说话人接下来要谈什么，以及他或她会如何组织语言，你都会有所预期。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now let’s come to the last thing a listener must do: the listener must evaluate, as he or she is listening, decide what’s important, what’s not, decide how something relates to something else.
sentences.zh: 现在来看听众必须做的最后一件事：边听边评价，判断什么重要、什么不重要，以及某件事与另一件事之间有什么联系。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: OK?
sentences.zh: 明白吗？
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: There are again two reasons for this.
sentences.zh: 这样做同样有两个原因。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: The first one is evaluating helps you to decide what to take notes about: what's important to write down? what’s not important to write down?
sentences.zh: 第一个原因是，评价能够帮助你决定哪些内容值得记笔记：什么值得写下来？什么不值得写下来？
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: And the second reason is that evaluating helps you to keep information.
sentences.zh: 第二个原因是，评价有助于你记住信息。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Studies have shown that we retain more information if ideas are connected to one another rather than just individually remembered.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，如果各种想法彼此关联，而不是各自孤立地记忆，我们就能记住更多信息。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So for example, if I give you five ideas that are not related to one another, that’s much more difficult to remember than five ideas that are related.
sentences.zh: 比如，我给你五个彼此不相关的想法，它们会比五个相互关联的想法难记得多。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: So you can see evaluating helps you to remember information better because it connects ideas to one another.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可以看到，评价把各种想法联系在一起，因此能帮助你更好地记住信息。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: From what I’ve said so far, you can see there’s a lot involved in listening to lectures: language awareness, adding information, making predictions and evaluations.
sentences.zh: 从刚才的内容可以看出，听讲座涉及很多事情：语言意识、补充信息、进行预测和作出评价。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: I hope these will be useful to you in lecture comprehension.
sentences.zh: 我希望这些方法能有助于你们理解讲座。
sentences.speaker: lecturer

sentences.en: Now, both the government and the Opposition party agree that state schools are not good enough.
sentences.zh: 现在，政府与反对党都认为，公立学校还不够好。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: And the Opposition is coming up with some new proposals of their own to improve them.
sentences.zh: 反对党正在提出自己的一些新方案，试图改善这些学校。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: But is their approach really all that different from the government’s?
sentences.zh: 但是，他们的做法真的与政府的做法有那么大的不同吗？
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: Today, we have Theresa May, the Shadow Education Secretary from the Opposition, with us on the radio show.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们邀请到反对党的影子教育大臣特雷莎·梅，做客本台广播节目。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: Good afternoon, Theresa.
sentences.zh: 下午好，特雷莎。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: Can I remind you of what John Major said, only a few years ago, when he was prime Minister?
sentences.zh: 我想提醒您，几年前约翰·梅杰还是首相时说过的一番话。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 他说。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: “We should give people opportunity and choice.
sentences.zh: “我们应该给人们机会和选择。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: I don’t mean some people.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是某些人。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: I mean everyone, opportunity for all.” Well, that is precisely what the present government is saying: opportunity for all.
sentences.zh: 我指的是每个人，要让所有人都有机会。”而这正是现任政府所说的：人人都有机会。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: The hallmark of this government is that what they say and what they actually do is always different.
sentences.zh: 这个政府的特点就是，他们说的与实际做的总是不一样。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: And that’s no different in education.
sentences.zh: 在教育方面也是如此。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: What we see from the present government is they may talk about opportunity for all, they may talk about choice, but actually they are cutting opportunity and reducing choice.
sentences.zh: 我们看到，现任政府也许口口声声说人人都有机会、人人都有选择，但实际上，他们正在减少机会、缩小选择范围。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: And what I think is most damaging is that actually they are giving a message: don’t bother.
sentences.zh: 我认为，破坏性最大的是，他们实际上在传递一种信息：别费力了。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: If you're from a state school there are barriers to be put in your place.
sentences.zh: 如果你来自公立学校，就会有重重障碍挡在你面前。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: But, this is far from the truth: universities have been doing a very great deal to encourage state school pupils to apply.
sentences.zh: 但事实远非如此：大学一直在付出很大努力，鼓励公立学校的学生申请入学。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: The point is that we still haven’t got enough state school pupils applying to our leading universities.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，申请顶尖大学的公立学校学生仍然不够多。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: But your government had eighteen years to get more of them into Oxbridge.
sentences.zh: 可是，你们执政了十八年，本来可以让更多这样的学生进入牛津和剑桥。

w.m: n.牛津与剑桥两所大学的合称

sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: And indeed we increased the number of young people in this country going into university from one in eight to one in three.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们让本国年轻人的大学入学比例从八分之一提高到了三分之一。

w.m: phr.每八人中有一人；八分之一

sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: The number of state pupils being accepted by Oxford and Cambridge, and other leading universities, the proportion of state pupils has actually increased, but there is a problem in many of our secondary schools, of expectations, and it’s the present Government that has been levelling down expectations, rather than raising them.
sentences.zh: 被牛津、剑桥及其他顶尖大学录取的公立学校学生比例，实际上已经提高了。但是，我们许多中学的学生对未来的期望存在问题；当前政府一直在降低这些期望，而不是提高它们。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: But I was talking about pupils from state schools going to the so-called elite universities.
sentences.zh: 但我说的是，进入所谓精英大学的公立学校学生。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: That didn’t go up during your time.
sentences.zh: 你们执政期间，这个比例并没有上升。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: The number from the state schools, who are going to leading universities, has increased over the years, but there is still an issue about ensuring that pupils from our state schools apply to go into the universities, and if you look at the Oxford figures, for example, you see that the percentage of students applying to Oxford from the state schools is about 1%, whereas from the private schools it’s over 4.5%, so that, you know, that’s the problem, it’s expectations in the state system that have been driven down by this Government over the years.
sentences.zh: 这些年来，来自公立学校、进入顶尖大学的学生人数有所增加，但如何确保公立学校学生积极申请大学，仍是一个问题。以牛津的数据为例，公立学校学生申请牛津的比例大约是百分之一，而私立学校学生的这一比例超过百分之四点五。所以，你看，问题就在这里：这些年来，公立教育体系中的期望一直被本届政府压低。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: In Theresa’s view, what is the present government doing?
sentences.zh: 在特雷莎看来，现任政府正在做什么？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: What is the problem in secondary schools now?
sentences.zh: 现在中学存在什么问题？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: What can we learn from the interview?
sentences.zh: 我们能从访谈中了解到什么？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: What contribution does Theresa think her party has made in education?
sentences.zh: 特雷莎认为，她所在的政党在教育方面作出了什么贡献？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: What’s the man’s focus in this part of the interview?
sentences.zh: 在访谈的这一部分，男士关注的重点是什么？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: But, again, you had the opportunity to do that as well, I mean to get more children from state schools into those leading universities, and it didn’t happen.
sentences.zh: 可是，我还要再说一次，你们同样有机会做到这一点，也就是让更多公立学校的孩子进入那些顶尖大学，然而这并没有发生。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: We have been getting more children from state schools into the leading universities, and the universities have been working very hard at doing that.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在让更多公立学校的孩子进入顶尖大学，而大学也一直在为此付出很大努力。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: But I think there is going to be a real problem, in the short term, as a result of what the present government has been doing.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，由于现任政府的所作所为，短期内会出现一个真正的问题。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: Because they have been giving a message that there are barriers there, and we’ve seen it today, there are reports already that Cambridge has been finding state school pupils ringing up and saying that they are not going to bother to apply now.
sentences.zh: 因为他们一直在传递“有障碍挡在那里”的信息。我们今天就看到了这一点：已经有报道说，剑桥接到公立学校学生的电话，他们说自己现在不打算费力去申请了。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: That’s the real damage the Government has been doing, far from opening opportunities, they’re actually closing down opportunities.
sentences.zh: 这才是政府正在造成的真正损害。他们非但没有开放机会，反而正在堵住机会。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: Well, they’d argue with that of course, and what they would say is one of the things we want to do is improve the standard of our schools.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们会反驳这一点。他们会说，自己想做的事情之一，就是提高学校的办学水平。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: Now one of the ways they want to do it is to give schools the opportunity to run themselves more completely than they are doing at the moment, to give schools more powers, exactly the same as you.
sentences.zh: 他们想采取的一种做法，是让学校比现在更全面地自主管理，赋予学校更多权力，这和您的主张完全一样。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: You made a speech last night laying out the way you see the education system changing in this country.
sentences.zh: 您昨晚发表了一次演讲，阐述了您希望本国教育体系如何改变。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: I see no difference here at all between you and them.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，我完全看不出您与他们有什么不同。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: There’s a very great deal of difference actually.
sentences.zh: 实际上，区别非常大。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: The present government talks about freedom for schools, it talks about getting money into schools, but if you look in the detail of what they are proposing, the reality is very different.
sentences.zh: 现任政府在谈学校自由，也在谈把钱投入学校。但只要仔细看看他们提出的方案，就会发现实际情况完全不同。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: We genuinely want to make schools free, and give them the freedom to have all of the money to spend on what is going on in their schools...
sentences.zh: 我们确实想让学校拥有自主权，使学校有权使用全部经费，投入到校内正在开展的各项事务中……
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: ... all of it?
sentences.zh: ……全部经费吗？
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: ... well, the government say in the future eighty-five pence in the pound will go to the schools.
sentences.zh: ……嗯，政府说，将来每一英镑中会有八十五便士拨给学校。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: I want to make sure that every pound spent on schools is a pound spent in schools.
sentences.zh: 我希望确保，名义上为学校支出的每一英镑，实际上都花在学校里。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: I think schools should have the money and have the power to decide how to spend it because they know best what’s in the interest of their pupils.
sentences.zh: 我认为，学校应该掌握这笔钱，并且有权决定如何使用，因为学校最了解怎样做才符合学生的利益。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: Right, so the answer to my question was yes, all of that money will go to the schools, will it? —
sentences.zh: 那么，您对我的问题给出的答案就是“是”：所有这些钱都会拨给学校，对吗？
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: I want to see every pound spent on Schools,…
sentences.zh: 我希望看到，为学校支出的每一英镑……
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: ... well, you say, “all of the money being spent in schools going into schools.” Fine, but what does it mean in practice?
sentences.zh: ……嗯，您说“所有花在学校上的钱都进入学校”。好，但这在实际操作中是什么意思？
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: Does it mean, I repeat the question, that all of that money, all of it, will go to the schools?
sentences.zh: 我再问一次，这是否意味着，所有这些钱，全部都会拨给学校？
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: What it means is that all the money at the moment that is being spent on the schools should be spent in the schools, rather than...
sentences.zh: 这意味着，目前名义上花在学校上的所有经费，都应该真正花在学校里，而不是……
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: ... and on local...
sentences.zh: ……而不是花在地方……
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: ... rather than money, that is supposed to be spent on schools, but is being held back in bureaucracy.
sentences.zh: ……而不是让那些本应花在学校上的钱，被官僚机构扣留下来。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: So, at the moment, a certain amount of money goes to schools, a certain amount of money goes to local education authorities, are you saying that in future, no money will go to Local Education Authorities, but all of the money will go to the schools.
sentences.zh: 所以，目前有一部分钱拨给学校，另一部分拨给地方教育主管部门。您的意思是，将来将不再有经费拨给地方教育主管部门，而是全部拨给学校？
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: I mean, that’s a very straightforward question, isn’t it?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这不是一个非常直接的问题吗？
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: At the moment, what happens is that money goes to Local Education Authorities and they decide how much money is then going to be spent on the schools.
sentences.zh: 目前的情况是，经费先拨给地方教育主管部门，再由他们决定有多少钱会用于学校。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: Money is held back at those Education Authorities, and is held back initially at Central Government as well, for them to decide how it should be spent.
sentences.zh: 有些钱被扣留在这些教育主管部门，也有些钱一开始就被中央政府扣留，由他们决定如何使用。
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: I want that money to be actually in the schools, for the schools to decide how it should be spent...
sentences.zh: 我希望这笔钱真正交到学校手里，由学校决定如何支出……
sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: OK, thank you very much, Theresa, for talking to us on the programme.
sentences.zh: 好的，特雷莎，非常感谢您参加我们的节目。
sentences.speaker: I

sentences.en: Pleasure.
sentences.zh: 很荣幸。

w.m: n.荣幸；用作回应感谢的客气话

sentences.speaker: T

sentences.en: In Theresa’s view, what is school freedom?
sentences.zh: 在特雷莎看来，学校自由意味着什么？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: According to Theresa, who decides money for schools at the present?
sentences.zh: 根据特雷莎的说法，目前由谁决定学校经费？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: What is the role of the interviewer throughout the talk?
sentences.zh: 在整个谈话过程中，采访者扮演了什么角色？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: Why some state school pupils give up applying to leading universities?
sentences.zh: 为什么有些公立学校的学生放弃申请顶尖大学？
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: What do we learn about the money being spent on schools at the moment?
sentences.zh: 关于目前用于学校的经费，我们了解到什么？
sentences.speaker: announcer
